title: Revengeance is Mine, Part Llama
description: Revengeance is Mine, Part Llama — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Return to the Dig Site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Once again, kill [GG] Your Little Sister and recover the scroll from his corpse. Bring the scroll to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Return to the Dig Site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Once again, kill [GG] Your Little Sister and recover the scroll from his corpse. Bring the scroll to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Sweet Gosh on a pogo stick, I got to hand it to you...last time you beat down [GG] Your Little Sister, you got an ancient scroll from him. Unfortunately, and once again, while it was *an* ancient scroll, it was not *the* Ancient Scroll...of Ecto Neutrality.

Let's try this one last time...and even as I say last, I get the sneaking suspicion that I'll be seeing your again. Next time you see [GG] Your Little Sister, beat the tar out of him and grab whatever scroll he drops. Bring it back to Sir Ving and tell him, Many merry Mutants mistakenly make messes. Eventually, he's got to run out of junk scrolls and give up the real Ancient Scroll of Ecto Neutrality, right?

Turn-in:

The late Sir Vaiveir said, Many merry Mutants mistakenly make messes? Hm. That means this is supposed to be the Ancient Scroll of Ecto Neutrality. I beg your pardon, Dungeon Runner, but this doesn't seem to be the scroll you thought it was. Perhaps you can ask Sir Vaiveir if he has better information on the location of the true Ancient Scroll of Ecto Neutrality?

Objectives:

  • Kill [GG] Your Little Sister
  • Ancient Scroll ×1

Level range: 49–59
